description: Convex backend: make Spain scan history INSERT-only + batched, decoupled from the shared singleton, with cycleNumber/windowId/idempotencyKey on each row, age-based retention via cron, a batch HTTP route, and per-dossier/paginated queries using the by_application index. This is the storage foundation the worker and frontend depend on.
steps: schema.ts: in the spainWatcherScans table (~465-484) add v.optional fields cycleNumber (v.number), windowId (v.number), idempotencyKey (v.string), and a new index .index("by_idempotency", ["idempotencyKey"]). Keep by_ts and by_application. All new fields optional for backward compatibility with existing rows.

spainWatcher.ts: add internalRecordScanBatch (internalMutation) with args scans: v.array(v.object({ status, slotInfo?, screenshotStorageId?, errorMessage?, applicationId?, dossierName?, pageCaptures?, detectedServices?, detectedSlots?, scanTrace?, cycleNumber?, windowId?, idempotencyKey? })). Handler INSERTs one row per element; for each element with an idempotencyKey, first look it up via by_idempotency (q.eq) and SKIP if a row already exists. Return { inserted, skipped }. MUST NOT query or patch the spainWatcher singleton. Explicit return type.

spainWatcher.ts: extract the singleton telemetry patch + found-email-alert scheduling currently inside internalRecordScan into a new internalTouchSingleton (internalMutation) taking { status, slotInfo?, detectedSlots?, detectedServices?, dossierName?, screenshotStorageId? }. Keep the SINGLETON_PATCH_THROTTLE_MS throttle and the 30-min found-alert cooldown. Leave the legacy internalRecordScan in place for the single/found compat path BUT remove its inline prune-to-MAX_SCANS block (retention is now cron-based).

spainWatcher.ts: add internalPruneOldScans (internalMutation, no args) that deletes spainWatcherScans rows with ts < Date.now() - RETENTION_MS using the by_ts index (order asc, batched take loop). Add const SPAIN_SCAN_RETENTION_HOURS = Number(process.env.SPAIN_SCAN_RETENTION_HOURS ?? 48) bounded, RETENTION_MS = hours*3600_000. Remove the module-level MAX_SCANS usage from write paths (queries updated below).

spainWatcher.ts: rewrite getWatcherPaginated to use real pagination. When args.applicationId is set, query .withIndex("by_application", q => q.eq("applicationId", args.applicationId)); otherwise .withIndex("by_ts").order("desc"). Apply statusFilter with .filter() IN the query. Use ctx.db...paginate or a cursor/page computation that no longer does a global .take(200)+post-filter+slice. Preserve the returned shape { watcher, scans, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages, stats } that BotLogs.tsx reads; each scan still carries cycleNumber/windowId. Keep requireAdmin.

spainWatcher.ts: add getScansForDossier query ({ applicationId: v.string(), page?: v.number(), pageSize?: v.number() }) returning rows for one dossier via by_application, including cycleNumber/windowId, resolving screenshotUrl like the other queries, guarded by requireAdmin. Explicit return via handler.

crons.ts: create artifacts/joventy/convex/crons.ts if it does not exist (import { cronJobs } from "convex/server"; import { internal } ...; const crons = cronJobs(); crons.interval("spain-scan-prune", { minutes: 30 }, internal.spainWatcher.internalPruneOldScans, {}); export default crons;). If crons.ts already exists, append the single crons.interval registration without disturbing existing jobs.

http.ts: add http.route POST /hunter/spain-watcher/scan-result/batch mirroring /hunter/slot-discovery/batch (~1330). requireHunterKey; parse JSON (400 on parse failure); require body.scans to be a non-empty array (400 otherwise); sanitize each item (coerce types, pass through cycleNumber/windowId/idempotencyKey); call internal.spainWatcher.internalRecordScanBatch and on success return 200 { ok:true, inserted, skipped }. Wrap the mutation in try/catch: if the error message indicates an OCC/write-conflict (substring match on 'changed while' | 'conflict' | 'Documents') return 503 so the client retries; otherwise return 422. After a successful history insert, best-effort ctx.runMutation(internal.spainWatcher.internalTouchSingleton, {...most significant status in the batch: found>error>not_found...}) inside its own try/catch that swallows failure (history success must not depend on it).
acceptance_criteria: spainWatcherScans has optional cycleNumber, windowId, idempotencyKey and a by_idempotency index; existing rows (without these) remain valid.
internalRecordScanBatch inserts one row per cycle, skips rows whose idempotencyKey already exists, and never reads or patches the spainWatcher singleton.
The per-write global prune-to-200 is gone; retention is handled by internalPruneOldScans scheduled every 30 min in crons.ts.

getWatcherPaginated uses by_application when applicationId is set (filter in query) and by_ts otherwise, with pagination (no global take(200)+slice), returning the same object shape the frontend consumes.
getScansForDossier returns per-dossier rows including cycleNumber/windowId.

POST /hunter/spain-watcher/scan-result/batch returns 400 for invalid payloads, 200 {inserted,skipped} on success, 503 on OCC-type throw, 422 otherwise; the singleton touch is best-effort and cannot fail the insert.
verification: cd artifacts/joventy && pnpm run typecheck (confirms src/** unaffected; convex/** is excluded from this tsconfig)

If network/credentials available: cd artifacts/joventy && npx convex dev --once to run codegen and type-check convex functions; otherwise record in findings that convex codegen was not run offline and the code was manually reviewed against existing spainWatcher.ts/http.ts patterns.
Manual review: internalRecordScanBatch contains NO ctx.db.query("spainWatcher") and NO ctx.db.patch of the singleton.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Files touched (all inside worktree): artifacts/joventy/convex/schema.ts, spainWatcher.ts, http.ts, crons.ts + artifacts/slot-hunter/.env.example.

FOR FEAT-002 (worker) / FEAT-003 (frontend):

NEW HTTP ROUTE (worker should POST batched cycles here):
  POST /hunter/spain-watcher/scan-result/batch
  Auth: X-Hunter-Key header (requireHunterKey, same as other hunter routes).
  Body: { scans: Array<ScanItem> } — MUST be a non-empty array (400 otherwise; 400 also on JSON parse failure).
  ScanItem fields (all optional except status): { status: 'found'|'not_found'|'error', slotInfo?, screenshotStorageId?, errorMessage?, applicationId?, dossierName?, pageCaptures?, detectedServices?, detectedSlots?, scanTrace?, cycleNumber?: number, windowId?: number, idempotencyKey?: string }. All string fields are String()-coerced server-side; cycleNumber/windowId only kept if typeof === 'number'; status falls back to 'not_found' if not found/error.
  Responses: 200 { ok:true, inserted:number, skipped:number } on success; 503 { ok:false, error } when the mutation throws an OCC/write-conflict (msg matches /changed while|conflict|Documents/i) so the client (fetchWithRetry) retries; 422 { ok:false, error } for any other throw. Singleton touch after insert is best-effort (own try/catch) and can never fail the insert.
  idempotencyKey design (from context.chosen_design): `${windowId}:${applicationId ?? '_'}:${cycleNumber}`; windowId = top-of-hour epoch ms of the worker-start hour; cycleNumber = scan cycle index within the window. Re-POSTing a batch with the same keys is safe (dedup -> skipped++).

NEW/CHANGED CONVEX MUTATIONS (internal):
  internal.spainWatcher.internalRecordScanBatch(args: { scans: ScanItem[] }) -> { inserted, skipped }. INSERT-only; dedups by idempotencyKey via by_idempotency index; NEVER queries or patches the spainWatcher singleton (manually verified).
  internal.spainWatcher.internalTouchSingleton(args: { status, slotInfo?, detectedSlots?, detectedServices?, dossierName?, screenshotStorageId? }) -> void. Patches singleton telemetry + schedules found email alert, keeping SINGLETON_PATCH_THROTTLE_MS throttle + 30-min found cooldown.
  internal.spainWatcher.internalPruneOldScans(args: {}) -> { deleted }. Deletes spainWatcherScans with ts < Date.now() - RETENTION_MS using by_ts range (q.lt('ts', cutoff)), batched take(200) loop; also deletes screenshots from storage. Scheduled every 30 min via crons.ts ('spain-scan-prune').
  internal.spainWatcher.internalRecordScan — legacy single/found compat path kept; now also accepts cycleNumber/windowId/idempotencyKey; its inline prune-to-MAX_SCANS block was REMOVED (retention is cron-based now).

NEW/CHANGED CONVEX QUERIES (admin-guarded via requireAdmin):
  getWatcherPaginated(args: { page?, pageSize?, statusFilter?, applicationId? }) -> { watcher, scans, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages, stats }. Rewritten: uses by_application index (with in-query .filter on status) when applicationId set, else by_ts desc with in-query status .filter; no more global take(200)+post-filter+slice. Each scan row carries cycleNumber/windowId/idempotencyKey + resolved screenshotUrl. Shape preserved for BotLogs.tsx. stats = { total, found, notFound, errors } over the dossier scope (or current filtered-by-ts set).
  getScansForDossier(args: { applicationId: v.string(), page?: v.number(), pageSize?: v.number() }) -> { scans, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages }. Per-dossier rows via by_application, sorted ts desc, each with cycleNumber/windowId + screenshotUrl. pageSize default 50 (max 100). FEAT-003 should use this for the Spain-specific per-dossier view and group with groupSpainScansByCycle (windowId desc -> cycleNumber desc; rows missing ids -> 'Hors cycle').

SCHEMA: spainWatcherScans gained optional cycleNumber (number), windowId (number), idempotencyKey (string) + index by_idempotency on [idempotencyKey]; by_ts and by_application retained; existing rows without the new fields stay valid.

TUNABLE: SPAIN_SCAN_RETENTION_HOURS (Convex-side env; default 48, bounded [1,720]) documented in artifacts/slot-hunter/.env.example (set via `npx convex env set`).

VERIFICATION: `cd artifacts/joventy && pnpm run typecheck` -> exit 0 (src/** unaffected; convex/** excluded from that tsconfig).
